description: Professional men's tennis singles, ATP only. One row per match; random player A orientation; target1 means A won/advanced. All 36 sporting columns reverse sign when A and B are swapped. NO market prices, player identities or match outcomes are input features. The first9 sports inputs are surface Elo logit, pre-match serve/return matchup logit, recent opponent-adjusted total-points form, short-memory serve/return strength, games-weighted Elo, observed 14day workload difference, surface-familiarity difference, age difference and centered squared-age difference. The new27 inputs include serve/return point performance minus each player's own expected performance given own and opposing strength, at28/182day half-lives and their difference; a partially pooled surface residual correction; effective point exposure and variability interactions; observed recovery/retirement history; and prior-days event serve residuals interacting with style and Elo. Missing history uses explicit neutral priors and coverage controls, not guessed injury or rest. All history is rebuilt using trusted match days; new rolling states use strictly earlier days. Training ends in2025, future evaluation is2026 only. Optimize probability log loss.
